text: Kesariya Stupa is a celebrated destination in East Champaran, Bihar, renowned for its heritage, monuments, pilgrimage sites. Located in the historic and scenic region of Bihar, it holds deep cultural, geographical, and architectural significance. Visitors explore this site to experience the authentic traditions, local atmosphere, and scenic beauty of Bihar. The best time to plan a visit is generally October to March (pleasant weather, ideal for heritage monuments, wildlife, and cultural walks). Regional cuisines and seasonal festivals enrich the journey.
